demo.title: 0xinsider.sh
demo.code:
# No key needed: the sandbox answers every documented operation with example data
curl -s https://0xinsider.com/sandbox/api/v1/leaderboard | jq '.data[0] | {address, grade, realized_pnl}'

# Live: the largest recent Polymarket trades and the grade of the wallet behind each
curl -s 'https://api.0xinsider.com/api/v1/whale-trades?limit=10' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OXINSIDER_API_KEY"

# Live: one wallet's grade and settled P&L, with trust metadata
curl -s 'https://api.0xinsider.com/api/v1/trader/0xYourPolymarketWallet?expand=trust' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OXINSIDER_API_KEY"

setup: Try it with no key against the sandbox at https://0xinsider.com/sandbox/api/v1 (example data, nothing stored).
For live data, create an API key at https://0xinsider.com/developers (live keys need an active Pro subscription) and export it as OXINSIDER_API_KEY. Never write it into a file.
Optional: point an MCP client at https://api.0xinsider.com/api/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Authorization: Bearer).
